distribution.summary: 安徽；福建；贵州；海南；香港；江苏；江西；陕西；上海；四川；云南；浙江；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984), 黄复生等 (2015) and Smith et al. (2020) already support the current distribution including Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports Taiwan; its broad China regional wording is not converted into province records. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Baseline and Smith et al. (2020) hosts are retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds the resolved Taiwan hosts Cinnamomum camphora and Pinus spp.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cnestus mutilatus (Blandford, 1894).

nomenclature_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) used Xyleborus mutilatus and 黄复生等 (2015) used Hadrodemius mutilatus. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Cnestus mutilatus. The current canonical identity remains Cnestus mutilatus (Blandford, 1894), VSN_1122.
